t2.thesis: WDC enters the print after a sharp selloff with a high bar and an implied move of about 8.4%, and it fell on three of its last four prints despite beating, so the next-open reaction is close to a coin flip with a slight lean to the downside.
reasons: Past beats did not lift the stock: three of the last four reactions were negative, including -21% in August on a 7.9% EPS beat (I2).
Expectations are high: consensus EPS of 4.08 sits above the 4.00 guidance midpoint, and EPS estimates have been revised up 9% over 90 days (I2, I4).

The stock is down 49% from its 52w high and down 18% over 1m, with HDD and memory selloff fears (CXMT, AI funding, Morgan Stanley target cut), which raises the bar but also leaves room for a relief bounce (I2, I19, I22).
Valuation is low at about 11x forward P/E, there is a Morgan Stanley buy stance, and positive AI-demand sentiment, which supports upside (I2, I15).
The entry is the open on the print day and the exit is the next open, so the hold carries the full earnings gap with an implied move of 8.4% and IV about 1.56x realized vol.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether Q2 revenue and the FQ2 guide (above the roughly $4.5B implied by consensus) and HDD pricing/demand commentary beat elevated whisper numbers enough to offset AI-funding and competition worries.

prior.from: I3: semis cluster hit 0.479 (n=434), hardware_networking 0.586, AMC overall 0.538, overall ~0.54. WDC is storage/hardware with AI exposure, so I blend to about 0.51.

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. I don't have information on how WDC's stock moved after its 2026-10-22 earnings report, since that is at or beyond what I know.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered about 4 points from 0.51 to 0.47: three of four recent prints fell despite beats, and the sell-the-news setup, with consensus already above guidance, outweighs the valuation and oversold support.

theses.expected: Beat and raise with strong HDD pricing and long-term agreements; the stock gaps up.
theses.mechanism: The depressed stock, low forward P/E and an oversold setup produce a relief rally on confirmation of durable demand.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is only in line with the elevated consensus and the stock opens flat or lower.

theses.expected: Beat but sell-the-news; the stock opens lower.
theses.mechanism: EPS consensus already sits above the guidance midpoint, so a modest beat is priced in and AI-funding and competition concerns dominate.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance exceeds consensus by a wide margin and margins surprise to the upside.

theses.expected: Muted move with an open near flat, decided by market beta.
theses.mechanism: The implied move of 8% is already large and the print is a known quantity, so the reaction is dominated by the memory and AI tape on the morning after.
theses.wrong_if: A large surprise in either direction produces a gap of more than 8%.

key_observations: FQ2 revenue and gross margin guidance versus consensus
HDD pricing and long-term agreement commentary
Capex and AI funding or hyperscaler demand remarks
Buyback pace and share count from convertible conversions
